purpose: remove residual dark hand and finger layers visible mainly from the unobserved side of each capture
maskMeaning: sorted original source PLY vertex rows
applyStage: after coverage confidence weighting and opacity attenuation

algorithm.method: integrated front-to-back alpha contribution from actual anisotropic Gaussian rasterization
algorithm.cameraCenter: mean original native positions of baseline hand contribution
algorithm.primaryCriterion: unobserved visible alpha flux > 2 * observed flux and DC luminance < 0.38
algorithm.fingerCriterion: unobserved visible alpha flux > observed flux and DC luminance < 0.40
algorithm.scope: baseline left_hand labels only; no forearm rows

rejectedTrials: Tighter native depth shells barely affected dark finger layers; global visibility ratio 0.12 and distal dominance 0.3 caused skin pitting. No color replacement or geometry changes were used.
